title: AI Engineer
description:
We're working with an early-stage startup building AI-powered products and are looking for an AI Engineer to support the development of new features and intelligent tooling.

This is an ideal opportunity for a Software Engineer who has gained exposure to AI technologies and is looking to build on that experience in a fast-paced startup environment.

The Role
  • Develop and maintain AI-powered applications using Python and JavaScript/TypeScript
  • Integrate LLMs and AI services into customer-facing products
  • Build APIs and backend services
  • Collaborate with product and engineering teams to deliver new functionality
  • Contribute to architecture decisions and product development
  • Support deployments and ongoing improvements across the platform
Requirements
  • Commercial experience as a Software Engineer or AI Engineer
  • Strong Python development skills
  • Experience with JavaScript or TypeScript
  • Exposure to AI technologies such as LLMs, AI agents, prompt engineering, RAG, or AI-powered applications
  • Previous experience working within a startup or scale-up environment
  • Comfortable taking ownership and working autonomously in a remote team
Desirable
  • FastAPI, Django or Node.js experience
  • AWS, Azure or GCP exposure
  • Docker and CI/CD knowledge
  • Experience delivering AI products into production
What's on Offer
  • Fully remote working
  • 6-month initial contract with extension potential
  • Join a growing startup at an exciting stage of growth
  • Opportunity to work directly on AI products with real-world impact
